paperTitleZh: 歷年模仿卷（2019）— 試卷二
instructionsZh: 本試卷共 45 題，全部為多項選擇題。第 1–30 題為甲部，第 31–45 題為乙部。每題一分，答錯不扣分。
instructionsEn: There are 45 questions in this paper, all of which are multiple-choice questions. Questions 1–30 are in Section A and Questions 31–45 are in Section B. Each question carries 1 mark. No marks are deducted for wrong answers.

questions.category: 二次函數的圖像/Graphs of Quadratic Functions
questions.questionText:
下列關於 $y=(5-x)(x+3)-8$ 的圖像的敘述，何者為正確？
I. 圖像開口向下。
II. 圖像通過點 $(1,10)$ 。
III. 圖像的 $x$ 軸截距為 $-3$ 及 $5$ 。
Which of the following statements about the graph of $y=(5-x)(x+3)-8$ is/are true?
I. The graph opens downwards.
II. The graph passes through the point $(1,10)$ .
III. The $x$-intercepts of the graph are $-3$ and $5$ .

Denote the circle $3x^{2}+3y^{2}-12x+18y-9=0$ by $C$ . Which of the following is/are true?
I. The area of $C$ is $16\pi$ .
II. The point $(7,-3)$ lies inside $C$ .
III. The centre of $C$ lies in the fourth quadrant.

questions.questionText:
下表顯示某些學生一年內獲得的優點數目的分佈。
優點數目：$3,4,5,6,7$
學生人數：$5,9,12,8,6$
下列何者為正確？
The table below shows the distribution of the numbers of merits obtained by some students in a year.
Number of merits: $3,4,5,6,7$
Number of students: $5,9,12,8,6$
Which of the following is true?

options.A:
分佈的眾數為 $12$ 。
The mode of the distribution is $12$ .
options.B:
分佈的中位數為 $5$ 。
The median of the distribution is $5$ .
options.C:
分佈的下四分位數為 $3$ 。
The lower quartile of the distribution is $3$ .
options.D:
分佈的上四分位數為 $7$ 。
The upper quartile of the distribution is $7$ .

questions.category: 三角形的內心與外心/Centres of Triangles
questions.questionText:
若 $\triangle ABC$ 為一直角三角形，其中 $\angle ABC=90^\circ$ ，下列何者為正確？

II. $\triangle ABC$ 的形心位於 $\triangle ABC$ 內。
III. $\triangle ABC$ 的內心位於 $\triangle ABC$ 外。
If $\triangle ABC$ is a right-angled triangle with $\angle ABC=90^\circ$ , which of the following is/are true?
I. The orthocentre of $\triangle ABC$ lies at $B$ .
II. The centroid of $\triangle ABC$ lies inside $\triangle ABC$ .
III. The in-centre of $\triangle ABC$ lies outside $\triangle ABC$ .

options.C:

options.D:
只有 I 及 II
